verses.en: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
verses.pt: E eu, irmãos, não pude vos falar como a espirituais, mas como a carnais, como a meninos em Cristo.
verses.en_web: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And the teaching I gave you, my brothers, was such as I was able to give, not to those who have the Spirit, but to those who are still in the flesh, even to children in Christ.

verses.en: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.
verses.pt: Com leite eu vos criei, e não com alimento sólido, porque não podíeis; nem mesmo agora ainda podeis;
verses.en_web: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, not even now are you ready,
verses.en_bbe: I gave you milk and not meat, because you were, then, unable to take it, and even now you are not able;

verses.en: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
verses.pt: porque ainda sois carnais. Pois, havendo entre vós inveja, brigas, e divisões, por acaso não sois carnais, e andais fazendo conforme o costume humano?
verses.en_web: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
verses.en_bbe: Because you are still in the flesh: for when there is envy and division among you, are you not still walking after the way of the flesh, even as natural men?

verses.en: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?
verses.pt: Porque dizendo um: “Eu sou de Paulo”, e outro: “Eu sou de Apolo”, por acaso não sois carnais?
verses.en_web: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
verses.en_bbe: For when one says, I am of Paul; and another says, I am of Apollos; are you not talking like natural men?

verses.en: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
verses.pt: Ora, quem é Paulo, e quem é Apolo, senão servidores, pelos quais crestes, conforme o Senhor deu a cada um?
verses.en_web: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed; and each as the Lord gave to him?
verses.en_bbe: What then is Apollos? and what is Paul? They are but servants who gave you the good news as God gave it to them.

verses.en: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
verses.pt: Eu plantei; Apolo regou; mas foi Deus quem deu o crescimento.
verses.en_web: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
verses.en_bbe: I did the planting, Apollos did the watering, but God gave the increase.

verses.en: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
verses.pt: De maneira que nem o que planta é algo, nem o que rega; mas sim Deus, que dá o crescimento.
verses.en_web: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
verses.en_bbe: So then the planter is nothing, and the waterer is nothing; but God who gives the increase.

verses.en: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.
verses.pt: E o que planta e o que rega são um; mas cada um receberá a sua recompensa segundo o seu trabalho.
verses.en_web: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
verses.en_bbe: Now the planter and the waterer are working for the same end: but they will have their separate rewards in the measure of their work.

verses.en: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God’s husbandry, ye are God’s building.
verses.pt: Porque somos cooperadores de Deus; vós sois a plantação de Deus, o edifício de Deus.
verses.en_web: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
verses.en_bbe: For we are workers with God: you are God's planting, God's building.

verses.en: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.
verses.pt: Segundo a graça de Deus que me foi dada, eu, como sábio construtor, pus o fundamento; e outro edifica sobre ele; mas cada um veja como edifica sobre ele.
verses.en_web: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
verses.en_bbe: In the measure of the grace given to me, I, as a wise master-builder, have put the base in position, and another goes on building on it. But let every man take care what he puts on it.

verses.en: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Pois ninguém pode pôr fundamento diferente do que já está posto, o qual é Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For there is no other base for the building but that which has been put down, which is Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
verses.pt: E se alguém sobre este fundamento edificar ouro, prata, pedras preciosas, madeira, feno, palha,
verses.en_web: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble;
verses.en_bbe: But on the base a man may put gold, silver, stones of great price, wood, dry grass, cut stems;

verses.en: Every man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.
verses.pt: a obra de cada um se manifestará; porque o dia a esclarecerá; pois pelo fogo se descobre; e qual é a obra de cada um, o fogo fará a prova.
verses.en_web: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
verses.en_bbe: Every man's work will be made clear in that day, because it will be tested by fire; and the fire itself will make clear the quality of every man's work.

verses.en: If any man’s work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
verses.pt: Se a obra de alguém que construiu sobre ele permanecer, receberá recompensa.
verses.en_web: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
verses.en_bbe: If any man's work comes through the test, he will have a reward.

verses.en: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
verses.pt: Se a obra de alguém se queimar, ele sofrerá perda; porém o tal se salvará, todavia, como que passado pelo fogo.
verses.en_web: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
verses.en_bbe: If the fire puts an end to any man's work, it will be his loss: but he will get salvation himself, though as by fire.

verses.en: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
verses.pt: Não sabeis vós, que sois o templo de Deus? E que o Espírito de Deus habita em vós?
verses.en_web: Don’t you know that you are a temple of God, and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
verses.en_bbe: Do you not see that you are God's holy house, and that the Spirit of God has his place in you?

verses.en: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
verses.pt: Se alguém destruir o templo de Deus, Deus ao tal destruirá; porque o templo de Deus é santo, o qual sois vós.
verses.en_web: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
verses.en_bbe: If anyone makes the house of God unclean, God will put an end to him; for the house of God is holy, and you are his house.

verses.en: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
verses.pt: Ninguém se engane; se alguém entre vós nestes tempos pensa ser sábio, que se faça de louco, para que seja sábio.
verses.en_web: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.
verses.en_bbe: Let no man have a false idea. If any man seems to himself to be wise among you, let him become foolish, so that he may be wise.

verses.en: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.
verses.pt: Pois a sabedoria deste mundo é loucura para Deus; porque está escrito: Ele toma aos sábios pela sua própria astúcia.
verses.en_web: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
verses.en_bbe: For the wisdom of this world is foolish before God. As it is said in the holy Writings, He who takes the wise in their secret designs:

verses.en: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
verses.pt: E outra vez: O Senhor conhece os pensamentos dos sábios, que são vãos.
verses.en_web: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
verses.en_bbe: And again, The Lord has knowledge of the reasonings of the wise, that they are nothing.

verses.en: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;
verses.pt: Portanto ninguém se orgulhe em seres humanos; porque tudo é vosso,
verses.en_web: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
verses.en_bbe: So let no one take pride in men. For all things are yours;

verses.en: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;
verses.pt: seja Paulo, seja Apolo, seja Cefas, seja o mundo, seja a vida, seja a morte, seja o presente, seja o futuro; tudo é vosso.
verses.en_web: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
verses.en_bbe: Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

verses.en: And ye are Christ’s; and Christ is God’s.
verses.pt: Mas vós sois de Cristo; e Cristo, de Deus.
verses.en_web: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
verses.en_bbe: And you are Christ's; and Christ is God's.
